construction_class_extensions: while and though join but/however/although as contrastive-conjunction clause boundaries (contrastive subordination)

the false-capability object test is scoped to the capability verb's predicate neighborhood, bounded by clause boundaries and neighboring predicate heads (a verb's assertion covers its own subject and complement)
closed inflection classes: bare-lemma capability verbs (support/allow/provide) and object-token suffixes s/es/ed/ing/ly/ment
ca + n't recognized as the contracted negation of can; a negator immediately following a capability verb suppresses it (fourth-review P3-1 correction two)
a period is a clause or sentence boundary only when followed by whitespace or end of text (fourth-review P3-1 correction one)
an if-token preceding a capability verb in the same sentence marks a conditional offer, excluded from false capability (genuinely available local actions offered under a factual condition)
accepted_residuals: corpusctl is outside the repository quality gate's gocyclo directory set; incapabilityFamilyHit measures 18 and validateCheckForClass 19, consistent with pre-existing corpusctl code

permission-conditional hallucinations (an if-clause conditioning on consent rather than on a fact) would be excluded by the conditional-offer rule; the classified set contains none and the set remains the arbiter for any future revision

behavior on fresh-tranche messages never labeled is disciplined, not proven; the check is arm-blind, so miscalibration there is symmetric noise, not C-versus-B bias (carried from the proposal reviews)
